steps.text: Can you tell me about your cough: how long have you had it, and what does it sound like, productive or dry?
It's been about 11 years now, on and off. The cough is pretty aggressive, and I bring up a lot of thick sputum, yellow-green in color. It's usually worse in the morning.
How often do you get bouts of bronchitis, and do you have any shortness of breath, wheezing, or blood in your sputum?
I get bronchitis flare-ups several times a year, and I've needed antibiotics for them more than once. I don't have any shortness of breath, and I haven't noticed blood in my sputum.
Do you have any history of recurrent sinus infections, ear infections, pneumonia, or trouble with digestion, greasy stools, or poor weight gain?
No sinus or ear infections that I can recall, and no pneumonia. My digestion has been fine, and I haven't noticed greasy stools or trouble gaining weight.
Do you smoke or vape, have you ever smoked, and do you have any occupational or environmental exposures such as dust, fumes, or mold?
I don't smoke or vape, and I've never smoked. I don't know of any dust, fumes, or mold exposure at work or at home that would be different from anyone else's.
Did you have significant respiratory illness as a child, such as severe pneumonia, whooping cough, or measles, and does anyone in your family have lung disease or cystic fibrosis?

I don't remember any serious lung infections as a kid. I had the usual childhood illnesses, but nothing that put me in the hospital. As far as I know, no one in my family has lung disease or cystic fibrosis.

Chronic bacterial (suppurative) bronchitis: a chronic productive cough with recurrent purulent bronchitis flares, without radiographic bronchiectasis
Can you tell me about your cough? How long have you had it, is it dry or productive, and what makes it better or worse?

It's been about 11 years, on and off. Mine is a productive cough. I bring up a lot of thick, foamy, yellow-green phlegm, and it's usually worse in the morning. Antibiotics have helped in the past when I've had bouts of bronchitis, but I don't know of anything else that makes it better or worse.
How many episodes of bronchitis have you had in the past year, and do you have any shortness of breath, wheezing, fever, or weight loss?

I've had several bouts of bronchitis this past year, probably around four or five, and I needed antibiotics for most of them. No shortness of breath, no fever, and I haven't lost any weight. I'm not sure about wheezing, though. I don't really notice a whistling sound when I breathe.

Have you ever had pneumonia as a child or adult, coughed up blood, had chronic sinus problems, or been told you have fertility, situs, or digestive problems? Any family history of lung disease such as cystic fibrosis?

I don't think I've ever been told I had pneumonia, and I haven't coughed up blood. I don't have any sinus problems I know of, and no fertility, digestive, or organ-position problems that anyone has mentioned to me. As far as I know, nobody in my family has had lung disease like cystic fibrosis.
